name: soma-appium-mcp-runtime
description: Pins appium-mcp and, through package-lock.json, its whole dependency tree. Installed by scripts/start-appium-mcp.mjs with npm ci --ignore-scripts. supportedNode is the Node.js range the whole tree supports; the launcher refuses other versions (scripts/node-range.mjs) and CI checks it against every package (scripts/check-node-range.mjs).
